description_expanded: Relax, you’re on beach time at Southern Style, a stunning home just off 30A in Santa Rosa Beach! With plenty of green space for the kids, a private pool, and just minutes from the beach, this gorgeous retreat is the perfect place for your next getaway! Southern Style is a cozy home with three bedrooms and two baths accommodating up to seven. Stunning grounds set amid beautiful shade trees welcome you in after long days at the beach, and beautiful interiors will have you settling into the coastal lifestyle in no time! The living room features a sofa, chairs, plenty of windows bringing in natural light, and a cozy fireplace to take the chill out of cooler evenings. You’ll have no problem whipping up fantastic creations in the expansive kitchen with upgraded appliances. A breakfast bar is a lovely spot for morning coffee while the kids enjoy breakfast at the dining table. Make those picture-perfect days last a little longer, and dine alfresco on the patio! Grill up burgers or your catch-of-the-day and relax under the stars while the kids play in the yard and pool. When it’s time to retire, unwind in a generous master suite with a king-sized bed, an en suite bath, and plenty of storage space for your belongings. A guest suite with a queen-sized bed and an additional guest suite with three twin beds ensure everyone gets a good night’s rest. A full-sized washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay. Whip up your favorite snacks and beverages, and head to the private pool for hours of relaxation. If you’re feeling motivated come afternoon, the beach is just a few blocks away, or rent bikes, hit the Timpoochee Trail, and explore 30A! Head west and hit the shops at Seaside and Grayton Beach, or venture east for a delightful selection of restaurants, including Cafe’ 30A and Old Florida Fish House, and enjoy incredible scenery along the way! Requests for pool heating must be submitted at least a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee if requested within the week of arrival. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
